```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
here::i_am("errata.qmd")

archive <- here("maintained", "archive_run", "replication_archive")
slopes <- read_csv(here("maintained", "output", "corrected_slopes.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
signs <- read_csv(here("maintained", "output", "sign_audit.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
ads <- read_csv(file.path(archive, "data", "ad_df_emotions.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
exps_clean <- read_rds(file.path(archive, "data", "exps_clean.rds"))
pairwise <- read_rds(file.path(archive, "data", "estimates", "observed_pairwise_frame.rds"))

slope <- function(spec, dv_name, index_name, column = "estimate") {
  hit <- slopes |> filter(specification == spec, dv == dv_name, index == index_name)
  stopifnot(nrow(hit) == 1)
  hit[[column]]
}
label <- function(spec, dv_name, index_name) {
  sprintf("%.3f (%.3f)", slope(spec, dv_name, index_name), slope(spec, dv_name, index_name, "std_error"))
}
shift <- function(dv_name, index_name, spec) {
  str_glue("{label('published', dv_name, index_name)} becomes {label(spec, dv_name, index_name)}")
}

# The opening paragraph says no article-figure slope reaches significance under any correction.
figure_rows <- slopes |> filter(index != "rating_index", index != "intended" | dv %in% c("Favorability", "Vote Choice"))
stopifnot(all(figure_rows$p_value > 0.05))

corrected_slope <- slope("sanders", "Favorability", "rating_index")
stopifnot(slope("sanders", "Favorability", "rating_index", "p_value") < 0.05)
two_ad_n <- n_distinct(pairwise$caseid)

primary <- exps_clean |> filter(election_phase == "Primary Election", ad_id != 3) |> distinct(ad_id) |>
  left_join(ads, by = join_by(ad_id), relationship = "one-to-one")
positive_primary <- sum(primary$emotion_valence == "positive")
republican_attacks <- primary |> filter(ad_valence == "Anti Trump", ad_sponsor %in% c("our principles pac", "cruz"))
attack_positive <- ads |> filter(str_detect(ad_valence, "Anti"), emotion_valence == "positive")
stopifnot(nrow(attack_positive) == 3, nrow(republican_attacks) == 3)
titles <- \(d) str_flatten_comma(str_c("“", d$ad_title, "”"), ", and ")
sign_count <- \(d) signs$sign_differs[signs$dv == d]
sign_total <- \(d) signs$estimates[signs$dv == d]
```

```{r entries}
# THE ERRATA SPINE. Numbering is APPEND-ONLY once this note is public. [[...]] marks the span
# that changes. A note-form entry corrects nothing, and its corrected field is NA.
entries <- tribble(

The slope stays significant. The same rows enter Figure 2, where {shift('Favorability', 'negative_index', 'sanders')} and {shift('Favorability', 'positive_index', 'sanders')}, and Figure 3, where {shift('Favorability', 'intended', 'sanders')}. The favorability tables C.1, C.6, C.11, and E.17 carry the same rows. No Figure 2 or 3 slope becomes distinguishable from zero."),

For issues the deposit's `ad_id_to_base_by_hand.csv` carries a `direction` column that no script reads, and it disagrees with the sign used in {sign_count('Target Issue Support')} of {sign_total('Target Issue Support')} estimates. Without the turnout flip and with `direction` on issues, Figure 4's labels change: on turnout, {shift('Turnout Intentions', 'negative_index', 'sign')} and {shift('Turnout Intentions', 'positive_index', 'sign')}; on issues, {shift('Target Issue Support', 'negative_index', 'sign')} and {shift('Target Issue Support', 'positive_index', 'sign')}. ) |>
  mutate(across(c(title, published, corrected, note, claim_ids, corrected_values), as.character))

stopifnot(nrow(entries) == max(entries$entry), !anyDuplicated(entries$entry),
          all(is.na(entries$corrected) == (entries$form == "note")),
          all(!is.na(entries$corrected_values) == (entries$class == "quantity")))

# Each corrected value must sit inside a marked span of its corrected sentence.
values_in_spans <- function(corrected, values) {
  spans <- str_remove_all(str_c(str_extract_all(corrected, "\\[\\[.*?\\]\\]")[[1]], collapse = " "), ",")
  all(str_detect(spans, fixed(str_split(values, ";")[[1]])))
}
quantities <- entries |> filter(class == "quantity")
stopifnot(all(map2_lgl(quantities$corrected, quantities$corrected_values, values_in_spans)))

bold <- function(x) str_replace_all(x, "\\[\\[(.*?)\\]\\]", "**\\1**")
emit_entry <- function(n) {
  e <- entries |> filter(entry == n)
  cat("\n\n## ", e$entry, ". ", e$title, "\n\nPublished, ", e$location, ":\n\n> ", bold(e$published), sep = "")
  if (e$form != "note") cat("\n\nCorrected:\n\n> ", bold(e$corrected), sep = "")
  cat("\n\n", e$note, "\n", sep = "")
}
```

This note lists corrections and three unresolved items in "Do Emotional Ads Persuade? Evidence from Real-Time Campaign Advertising Experiments," published in *Political Communication*, doi [10.1080/10584609.2026.2726266](https://doi.org/10.1080/10584609.2026.2726266). Page numbers are the journal's. **No slope in Figures 2, 3, or 4 becomes distinguishable from zero under any correction here, so the article's central null is unchanged.**

```{r article-entries, results="asis"}
walk(entries$entry, emit_entry)
```

```{r emit-spine}
write_csv(entries, here("errata_entries.csv"))
```
